diagnosis: Customer missed the manual replay window. According to kb-0015, events are available for manual replay for only seven days after the final automatic retry. The two-week outage far exceeds that retention period.
reply: I understand you had an extended outage and want to replay missed webhooks. Unfortunately, after the automatic retries complete, events are only available for manual replay for seven days (see kb-0015). Since your outage lasted two weeks, those events are no longer retrievable through the webhook replay feature. If you need help setting up monitoring or adjusting event handling to avoid this in the future, I’m happy to help.
